remarks: Enjoy easy single-floor living in this beautifully located 2-bedroom, 2-bath condominium featuring a bright, open-concept living and dining area with gas fireplace that flows to a large private deck overlooking mature trees and lush green space--an ideal setting for relaxing or entertaining. The spacious primary suite offers an en-suite bath and double-door closets, while the second bedroom features double-door closets and access to its own private terrace. Additional highlights include two underground garage parking spaces conveniently located near the elevator, and a professionally landscaped courtyard within the complex. Ideally located just minutes from the train, library, shopping, dining, and everyday conveniences, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and location. Additional storage located in garage.
